notes.title: Quietus Allurement Demo Update 13: Quality of Life update
notes.content:
[h1]General Update[/h1][p]Its been a while since we had an update about where the game is at. Well this update is defiantly going to help overall with the game. Are we getting closer to release not really I want the game to be the best it can be with the launch. With this update it defiantly feels more like a finished product.[/p][p]This update has been in the works for a while and with the changes that I've made Its defiantly a quality of life update. As Recoil is now a whole new system. This system has been rewritten over and over to find the right correct way of doing it. It finally turned into something I really enjoy.  [/p][list][*][p]We are still in progress working on making the survival map look more like it should! And making further changes on the playstyle to make it fit the genre of game.[/p][/*][*][p]We made Level 1 a little bit more interesting with the lights but we got more work to do yet. It still seems out of place. not fitting the genre.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][h3][b]General Changes[/b][/h3][p]Updated: Save/Loading code this will break current saves! I’m hoping this will work for the next update later on.[/p][p]Fixed: Breaking Platforms now save correctly.[/p][p]Fixed: Saving game No longer brakes audio[/p][p]Fixed: Loading Game wasn’t setting the audio correctly for voice lines.[/p][p]Added: Switching weapons now makes a sound.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Weapon Changes[/b][/h3][p]Weapons smoke effect only happens on non silenced weapons[/p][p]Weapons with silencer have a smaller flare and removal of smoke[/p][p]Weapon recoil has changed a lot making weapons a lot easier to control. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Electric[/b][/p][p]BUG: Does Not have a fire rate for auto. Have fun with this while you can. ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Story Mode[/b] [/h3][p]Added: Torch lights have a smoke trial.[/p][p]Fixed: Player arms are moving without actually moving Noticeable in Level 1.[/p][p]Fixed: Player head glowing in Level 1.[/p][p]Fixed: Player doesn't look like he's in a jump when he should be walking.[/p][p]Fixed: Player was getting stuck on the elevator not letting them jump and appeared to be floating when on the platform.[/p][p]Fixed: Elevator Sign clipping through player.[/p][p]Fixed: Potential Issue with saving and loading. [b]THIS WILL BREAK CURRENT SAVES![/b][/p][p]Fixed: Crash issue with flying monsters hitting the moving platform.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Survival Mode[/b][/h3][p]Added: Drops are now affected by gravity[/p][p]Changed Wall Weapon designs[/p][p]Updated: Ground Monsters are a little smarter.[/p][p][b]Santa’s Workshop[/b][/p][p]The starting area looks a little bit different. It's still working progress but it's getting there.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Quietus Allurement Demo Update 12: Sounds and Improvements!
notes.content:
[h1]Current Progress[/h1]
This update has been in the works for a while and I got to say its an amazing update.
[b]Here is what is coming in future updates.[/b]
[list]
[*] Making further changes to Weapon stats when adding attachments
[*] looking into a better survival experience. 
[*] thinking about taking a different approach to level 1. This level seems a bit bland for what it should be. so we will be doing an overhaul of that level in the coming updates! 
[/list]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]General Changes[/b]
Added: A death sound plays when you died screen pops up.
Added: Healing in story now has a sound effect to go with it. 
Added: Ground monsters now have death animations. 
Added: Flying monsters and ground monsters Squish gore sound.
Added: Gore sounds for all non critical shots
Added: Gore sounds for all critical shots.
Added: Gore sounds for all explosives
Added: Gore sound Volume Slider In options So you can turn these down or even off.
Changed: Death screen shows up till the sound stops.
Fixed: Explosive weapons were creating duds. [i]From Initial Testing it appears to be working better.[/i]
Fixed: Potential Memory leak with the dead monster objects
Fixed: Crash when using Phantom and switching to the next level when you are out of ammo on your clip.

[b]Weapon Changes[/b]
Added: Silencers now lower the detection range of Monsters Making silencers actually useful
Added: Silencers now lower the range by 1. And is shown in the attachment screen. [i]Other Stats of how other attachments make a difference are still work in progress.[/i]
Changed: Bullet Type weapons fire max damage but range is a factor for damage falloff..
	[b]Punchline[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage has been decreased to 14-18 [i]as I thought with the bullet damage changes was way too powerful for tier one weapons.[/i]
[/list]
	[b]Fallen Angel[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed: Bolt action is now a little faster and has been reworked to sound a lot better.
[*] Changed: Fallen Angels damage was increased. 
[*] Developer comments It felt like this change was necessary as I thought it was underpowered for what it should be doing.
[/list]
[b]M.I.A[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage wasn’t set correctly so it caused it to do lower damage than intended.
[/list]
	[b]Electric[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage wasn’t displayed in the buy menu of survival.
[*] BUG: This weapon doesn't show up in the weapon showcase. [i]This is planned to be reworked as changes need to be made.[/i]
[/list]

[b]Story Changes[/b]
Fixed: Player Arms stopped moving when running noticeable in level 1.
Changed: In Elevator level Monsters used to despawn now they don’t. Have Fun!

[b]Survival Changes[/b]
Added: TNT drop now plays a sound.
Added: Revive Bomb now plays a sound when it activates.
Fixed: Player Arms in survival with no weapon will act as running now.
Planned Reworks
Health Perk
Instead of Health giving you health right away it will be changed to where you have get a medkit again and you have medkit healing like Story mode has. But you will also receive 3 at the start of each survival game. [i]Healing is In progress of being switched over The UI has been switched but that is about it at this moment.[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update Version 8.1: Crash Fixes and Controller Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Development Update![/h1]
Over the last month I've seen a lot of issues with the controller. Some of which was to the point where these were very hard to find. I also found a few bugs that I thought were just a random thing that happened and I wasn't sure what caused it. But I think that is fixed now. So hopefully no more random crashes. We are doing only 8.1 instead of 9 because this update is only a little bit of the fixes I wanted to add in the 9 update! I'm hoping to add a whole lot more once we get controller support fully added and working to where it is bug free and enjoyable for the controller users! Thank you all for those that help test it and let me know of feedback. This has been an amazing journey so far working on my own game, I never thought I would even get to where I'm at a few years ago.

notes.title: Quietus Allurement Demo Update 7: 4K resolution Release!
notes.content:
As many of you know this update has a lot of changes to it like major improvements and removing the duplicates and redundancies of the game. So updates will be faster to change and will apply to all and not just one game mode or other things. This update has the ability for a higher screen resolutions then just 1920x1080 which is awesome and no more ARROWs.. The arrows in the video settings have been removed! as much as that system worked it was just to the point where it needed to be retired and changed to what it is now. Here is the overall Patch notes of the game which is still heavily being update and more demo updates will be coming!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
Added: up to 4k resolutions and a new selection feature for all video options.
Added: Options menu now shows more options for controls that are planned for full release of the game. Steam Deck and controller. We are working on controller support in the next patch or two. [b]Down below shows our phases and these will stay on each update to give you a heads up when you might see this happening..[/b]
Added: info page has changed and more pages have been added. [b]Info for these new pages is still work in progress at the moment.[/b]
Added: New Sniper Scope system with zoom. [b]Still work in progress will see more changes to them soon.[/b]
Fixed: Crash with sprinting in chapter 1 level 1.
Fixed: Voicelines in Chapter 1 Level 1 were being skipped.
Fixed: Cursor image was incorrectly displayed in the info screen.
Fixed: Crash with weapon showcase when clicking on sniper rifles
Changed/Optimization: This change isn't going to be noticeable but it will make the options menu a little easier to expand on to the future.
Removed: work in progress on survival menu option.
[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
This will be implemented in three phases.
[h3]Phase 1: [/h3]This phase consists of the main menu phase so anything in menus should be working. Will need more testing to find out for sure!
[h3]Phase 2: [/h3]This phase consists of the full game being able to be played with a controller..
[h3]Phase 3:[/h3] This phase consists of bug fixes. Improvements to overall controller support.

[h2]Survival Changes[/h2]
Removed: info button in survival menu as the info menu on the main menu has all the info needed for both.
Changed: Ground Monsters are now alerted later meaning less range and attack with less range. To allow more time to kill them. Developer Notes I thought this change was better than lowering the damage for now. More changes will be evaluated as time goes on.

[h3]Known issues[/h3]
This isn't very important just looks a little strange but it will be fix in the next update..
Chapter 1: Level 1: has a lighting issue bug.

notes.title: Devlopment Progress #18 Changes are coming!
notes.content:
So, it’s been almost two months since the last update and here’s a list of stuff we have been working on.
[h2][b]Sniper Scopes[/b][/h2]
I know this was not working properly in survival mode and I’ve been trying to figure out a new system for this to work better. After a lot of late nights thinking and long days of coding. There’s a new system going into place where its smoother and some surprises will be coming with that. Not only will this system work in story it also works in survival.
[h2][b]Info pages[/b][/h2]
The info pages are being added to the game this area kind of lack in the fact that it was very basic but I’m working on adding this in so we can get closer to finished. So the main focus after finishing these things will be the full game then.
[h2][b]Options Menu Changes[/b][/h2]
These are mainly just code changes but, in the controls, there is going to be changes in the fact that I’m getting prepared to add more options. New options are for Controller and Steam deck. Yes, I’m working towards having my game work with steam deck as much as possible.  I’m also working on getting stuff set up for controller. Support for controller is not there yet but we are working towards that and trying to improve those systems.

As always, I can’t thank you all enough for the support. This is my first game I’m really wanting to release and give to you all and these changes are slow but I’m working as hard as I can do for one person.

The last past month I've been working a lot on making it more universal for my code to where If I have to make a change it will change for both modes. I've been spending a lot of time with this because I don't want to break something in story and have it to where its unplayable.

I've also been trying to figure out the best method for the survival mode and where I want that game mode to be.

I'm hoping soon I'll have more details soon about level 1. I'm still awaiting voice lines but I'm thinking I'm gonna be going to a backup plan and get them quicker. Level 1 is done I just have to add the voice lines!

notes.title: Development Progress #9 Balancing tweaks
notes.content:
The demo has been out for almost a week now and overall I'm really impressed how well its been going! its giving me motivation in the game that I haven't had in a month or so. I had released an update to fix a few problems that were found. Now my goal is to start balancing the weapons that are overpowered.

[h1]Next update[/h1]
[list]
[*] The next update to the game will include a few bug fixes and a few new things in the levels and work in progress info screen which right now will include what the overlay shows and what everything does.
[*] There is a possibility of adding a level or 2 in the future update when that might I haven't decided yet the levels would have to go through some testing for sure. Below are other changes that is coming to the update. 
[/list]

[h1]Weapon Changes[/h1]
[h2]Headshots[/h2]
[list]
[*] Headshots are going to get changed to do less damage with armor.
[*] Headshots without armor are going to be adjusted to the weapons type so certain types will have more damage.
[/list]

[h2]Weapon Damages[/h2]
[list]
[*] The damages are going to get reworked to adjust to the fire rate and reload time.
[*] Range is also going to be a factor as well that I've haven't tested yet before. So this may take a little bit to figure out and [b]may not make this update.[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Enemy Difficulty[/h2]
[list]
[*] This has been in question about what needs to happen to make these guys tougher. Right now no changes are coming to the enemies the changes are going to be made to weapons right now. after weapon changes if they still are still easy I'll revaluate at that time.
[/list]

I just want to thank all those that are trying my demo! its been a long road to get to this spot and I never thought I would get to this spot especially right now!
